summary: Frontend-only visual test of /reports 'Répartition CA' pie chart fix (BEVID CRM, manager role). Login OK. Reports page loads. However the described fix (Top 8 + 'Autres', legend to the right vertical scrollable, h-80, innerRadius=40, currency tooltip, data-testid='ca-pie-container') has NOT been applied to /app/frontend/src/pages/Reports.jsx — the code at lines 92-105 is still the original problematic version. DOM check confirms data-testid 'ca-pie-container' is absent; container remains h-64; no aggregation logic; Legend uses default bottom position. Visual screenshot shows the pie is squeezed and legend items overlap/wrap next to the chart, exactly reproducing the bug the user reported.

ui_bugs.issue: Fix not applied. Current code still uses <div className='h-64'> with <Pie outerRadius={80}/> and <Legend/> (default bottom). No 'ca-pie-container' testid, no Top-8+Autres grouping, no innerRadius, no € tooltip formatter. Legend still overlaps/compresses the pie for many agents.

issues: Pie chart squeezed to ~164px wide (h-64 container with 10+ agents in legend). Legend swatches wrap around/beside the pie, cutting its visible area. Reproduces the reported overlap bug.

action_items: Actually apply the described fix to /app/frontend/src/pages/Reports.jsx lines 92-105: (1) wrap in data-testid='ca-pie-container', (2) increase height to h-80, (3) compute topN = 8 by CA desc and aggregate the rest as {name:'Autres (N)', ca: sum}, (4) set <Legend layout='vertical' align='right' verticalAlign='middle' wrapperStyle={{maxHeight:'260px', overflowY:'auto'}} />, (5) shift pie cx to '35%' or '40%' to leave room, (6) add innerRadius={40}, (7) Tooltip formatter that returns value.toLocaleString('fr-FR')+' €'.
critical_code_review_comments: Reports.jsx: PieChart currently rebuilds on every render with no memoization; for larger datasets (30+ agents claimed by user) consider useMemo for the aggregated series.
COLORS palette only has 5 entries — used with modulo, so many segments share colors. Consider extending palette to 9 (8 top + Autres).
seed_data_creation: None. Environment currently has 10 agents in perf data (not 30+ as user screenshot suggested), but bug is still visibly reproducible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Once main agent applies the fix to Reports.jsx (see action_items), rerun the same login + navigate to /reports and assert: (a) [data-testid='ca-pie-container'] exists, (b) title 'Répartition CA' bounding box does not vertically overlap with .recharts-legend-wrapper, (c) .recharts-pie width > 200px, (d) if agents with ca>0 > 8 then a legend item text starts with 'Autres (', (e) hover a slice → tooltip contains ' €'.
rca of the issue: Root cause of remaining bug: E1 described the fix in the review request but never wrote it to disk. Reports.jsx still contains the pre-fix implementation (verified by view_file lines 92-105 and DOM query for data-testid='ca-pie-container' returning null). No code change to test.
